theses.thesis: T1: Data center demand keeps NVIDIA's growth well above peers through fiscal 2027.
theses.signpost: Data Center revenue growth above 50% year over year in each FY2027 quarter reported, and Rubin production shipments starting in the second half of FY2027 [1][3].

theses.thesis: T2: Gross margin recovers above 72% as Blackwell yields mature and the H20 charge does not recur.
theses.signpost: Quarterly gross margin back above 72% by the end of FY2027 (January 2027) [1].

theses.thesis: T3: The stock is priced for a steep growth fade, so returns depend on consensus EPS being delivered.
theses.signpost: FY2027 EPS at or above the $9.67 consensus, and the FY2028 EPS estimate holding above $16 through the FY2027 year-end [3].

theses.thesis: T4: Free cash flow and net cash can absorb the China and customer shocks without strain.
theses.signpost: Net cash stays positive in each FY2027 quarter, and any H200 revenue is disclosed in the first half of FY2027 [1][2].
